title: Dwellings with Extensive Grounds
summary: Dwellings surrounded by extensive grounds (e.g. National Trust properties) are established as geographic headings (151) with a geographic qualifier, e.g. Great Chalfield Manor (England), with broader terms Dwellings--[place] and Gardens--[place], never Manors or Parks.
validation_rules: Headings for dwellings surrounded by extensive grounds are geographic headings (tag 151, MARC 651 in bibliographic use), not corporate (110) headings. (H 1572 sec. 1)
Such headings carry a geographic qualifier per the general guidelines (H 1334 sec. 3 as cited), e.g. `Great Chalfield Manor (England)`; `Attingham Park (England)`. (H 1572 sec. 2, 4)
Broader terms are `Dwellings--[place]` and `Gardens--[place]`; do not use `Manors` or `Parks` as broader terms even if part of the name. (H 1572 sec. 4)
For National Trust properties, generally favor the name found on the National Trust's Web site. (H 1572 sec. 5)

sections.heading: Background
sections.text: Many properties, especially those of the National Trust in Great Britain, consist of a dwelling that is surrounded by extensive park-like grounds or gardens. In the past, establishing subject headings for these properties has been problematic and inconsistent with respect to tagging the headings and providing appropriate broader term references. Some have been tagged 151; others have been tagged 110. Various headings have been assigned as broader terms, such as Parks, Dwellings, Manors, Gardens, etc. This instruction sheet provides standardized guidelines to be followed in establishing headings of this type in the future.

sections.heading: 1. General rule
sections.text: Establish headings for dwellings that are surrounded by extensive grounds as geographic entities tagged 151.

sections.heading: 2. Geographic qualifier
sections.text: Follow the general guidelines for geographic qualifiers in H 1334 sec. 3.

sections.heading: 3. UF references
sections.text: Follow the general guidelines for UF references (cf. H 373).

sections.heading: 4. BT references
sections.text:
Provide the following two broader term references:

```
550 $w g $a Dwellings $z [place]
550 $w g $a Gardens $z [place]
```

Do not use the headings Manors or Parks as broader terms even if one of these terms is part of the name of the entity being established.

Examples:

```
151 $a Great Chalfield Manor (England)
550 $w g $a Dwellings $z England
550 $w g $a Gardens $z England
```

```
151 $a Attingham Park (England)
550 $w g $a Dwellings $z England
550 $w g $a Gardens $z England
```

sections.heading: 5. National Trust properties
sections.text:
When establishing a heading for a property that is part of Great Britain's National Trust, generally favor the name found on the National Trust's Web site located at

http://www.nationaltrust.org.uk/main/
